description.it: Distribuire la guestbook application di esempio usando ArgoCD.
description.en: Deploy the sample guestbook application using ArgoCD.

exercises.task:
1. Crea un'applicazione che punta a argocd-example-apps
2. Usa il path 'guestbook'
3. Imposta destination su in-cluster
4. Namespace: guestbook
5. Sincronizza manualmente
hints: Usa argocd app create o un file YAML
exercises.solution:
kubectl create namespace guestbook
argocd app create guestbook --repo https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps --path guestbook --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace guestbook
argocd app sync guestbook
exercises.validation: argocd app get guestbook deve mostrare Status: Synced, Health: Healthy

description.it: Distribuire un chart Helm con values personalizzati.
description.en: Deploy a Helm chart with custom values.

exercises.task:
1. Crea app dal chart nginx-ingress Helm
2. Imposta values personalizzati via CLI
3. Usa targetRevision specifica
4. Verifica la configurazione
hints: Il chart Bitnami nginx-ingress su charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
Usa argocd app get per verificare
exercises.solution: argocd app create nginx-ingress --repo https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami --chart nginx-ingress --targetRevision 9.x.x --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace nginx --helm-set service.type=LoadBalancer
exercises.validation: argocd app get nginx-ingress --show-params deve mostrare i valori Helm

description.it: Configurare la sincronizzazione automatica con prune e selfHeal.
description.en: Configure automatic sync with prune and selfHeal.

exercises.task:
1. Modifica l'app guestbook per auto-sync
2. Abilita prune automatico
3. Abilita selfHeal
4. Testa modificando manualmente una risorsa
hints: O edita il file YAML della Application
Testa con kubectl edit su una risorsa
exercises.solution:
argocd app set guestbook --sync-policy automated --auto-prune --self-heal
# Test: kubectl edit deployment -n guestbook
# ArgoCD deve ripristinare entro 3 minuti
exercises.validation: Modificare manualmente una risorsa e verificare che ArgoCD la ripristina

description.it: Distribuire applicazioni usando Kustomize con overlays.
description.en: Deploy applications using Kustomize with overlays.

exercises.task:
1. Crea app dal path kustomize-guestbook
2. Verifica che Kustomize sia rilevato
3. Esamina i manifest generati
hints: Il path kustomize-guestbook negli example apps
Usa argocd app manifests per vedere l'output
exercises.solution:
argocd app create kustomize-app --repo https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps --path kustomize-guestbook --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace kustomize
argocd app sync kustomize-app
exercises.validation: argocd app manifests kustomize-app deve mostrare i manifest renderizzati

exercises.task:
1. Crea un ApplicationSet con List generator
2. Genera app per dev e prod
3. Applica e verifica le applicazioni create
exercises.solution:
cat > appset.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationSet
metadata:
  name: multi-env
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  generators:
  - list:
      elements:
      - env: dev
      - env: prod
  template:
    metadata:
      name: 'guestbook-{{env}}'
    spec:
      project: default
      source:
        repoURL: https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps
        path: guestbook
      destination:
        server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
        namespace: 'guestbook-{{env}}'
EOF
kubectl apply -f appset.yaml
exercises.validation: argocd app list deve mostrare guestbook-dev e guestbook-prod

description.it: Distribuire Helm con values file e parametri inline.
description.en: Deploy Helm with values files and inline parameters.

exercises.task:
1. Crea file values.yaml personalizzato
2. Configura app per usare values file
3. Aggiungi override inline
4. Verifica la configurazione finale
exercises.solution:
cat > my-values.yaml << 'EOF'
replicaCount: 3
image:
  tag: "1.21"
EOF
argocd app create my-nginx --repo https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami --chart nginx --targetRevision 13.x --values my-values.yaml --helm-set replicaCount=5 --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace nginx
exercises.validation: argocd app get my-nginx --show-params deve mostrare replicaCount=5 (override)

exercises.task:
1. Registra due cluster in ArgoCD
2. Crea ApplicationSet con Cluster generator
3. Verifica le applicazioni generate
hints: Prima registra i cluster con argocd cluster add
Cluster generator legge da Secret cluster
exercises.solution:
# Prima: argocd cluster add <context> --name staging
cat > cluster-appset.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationSet
metadata:
  name: cluster-apps
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  generators:
  - clusters: {}
  template:
    metadata:
      name: 'guestbook-{{name}}'
    spec:
      project: default
      source:
        repoURL: https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps
        path: guestbook
      destination:
        server: '{{server}}'
        namespace: guestbook
EOF
kubectl apply -f cluster-appset.yaml
exercises.validation: argocd app list deve mostrare applicazioni per ogni cluster

description.en: Create an application with multiple sources.

exercises.task:
1. Crea app con due sorgenti Git
2. Una per i manifest base, una per gli overlay
3. Sincronizza e verifica
exercises.solution:
cat > multi-source.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: multi-source-app
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  project: default
  sources:
  - repoURL: https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps
    path: guestbook
  - repoURL: https://github.com/org/overlays
    path: guestbook-overlays
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: guestbook
EOF
kubectl apply -f multi-source.yaml
exercises.validation: argocd app get multi-source-app deve mostrare entrambe le sorgenti

description.it: Eseguire rollback a una versione precedente.
description.en: Execute rollback to a previous version.

exercises.task:
1. Identifica la cronologia delle sincronizzazioni
2. Esegui rollback a versione precedente
3. Verifica lo stato
hints: Usa argocd app history per vedere le versioni
argocd app rollback per tornare indietro
exercises.solution:
argocd app history guestbook
argocd app rollback guestbook <revision-id>
argocd app get guestbook
exercises.validation: Verificare che l'app sia tornata alla versione specificata

description.en: Set up alerts for failed syncs.

exercises.task:
1. Configura l'integrazione Slack/Email
2. Imposta trigger per sync falliti
3. Testa inviando una sync che fallisce
exercises.solution:
kubectl edit cm argocd-notifications-cm -n argocd
# Aggiungi configurazione Slack
kubectl annotate app guestbook notifications.argoproj.io/subscribe.on-sync-failed.slack='my-channel' -n argocd
exercises.validation: Una sync fallita deve generare una notifica
